title: THE NEXT GUN KEYCAP NAMES RB ON A CONTROLLER
why: Since v26.02 each tactical belt key shows the key that acts on it, the controller button when a controller is on. The next gun key showed D-DOWN, but on a controller D-DOWN opens the item wheel and never changes the gun; the controller walks the belt with RB (the controls card says LB/RB change tactical belt slot). Proven in the cloud: with a controller on, the cap read D-DOWN, and a D-DOWN tap opened the wheel without changing the gun. With a controller on, that key now names the button the belt walk forward is on (RB by default, R1 on a PlayStation pad, or wherever he moved it). The keyboard still shows F, and the self-revive prompt still says D-DOWN.
now: On a controller the tactical belt's next gun keycap says RB, the button that changes to it.
